note: Private test IPA 762, for the maintainer's request of 16 November 2026 after the IPA 760 test at 30 frames a second (« Le jeu reste très instable et les FPS présentent toujours d'importantes fluctuations et de flickering sur les arbres … apporter des corrections concrètes à la Switch 2 … traite chaque piste étayée par les données »): the verified IPA 761 (run 43937309952, IPA 6c8a1288) with the S2Arm engine of patches 0001-0055 (run 43944027989, artifact 14265222547, verified pin c3057cf8, packagedFingerprint 7404879b): 0051 the depth output's register beside one-channel colour outputs (Mario Kart World's flat quarter-resolution depth, no ambient occlusion) and a capture that keeps its shaders' source; 0052 the game's mapped region stays in the window files on this phone (the carve of patch 0038 cost 1 GB of compressed memory and 40 to 60 % of the cores to the kernel in the sessions of 16 November); 0053 the compute and graphics queues' event order is kept (the near trees gone for single frames); 0054 a frame capture also takes a CPU profile and per-encoder GPU times; 0055 a capture leaves out image levels over 16 M pixels (two sessions ended on one). RPCS3 Core 941, the MeloNX Core, XeniaCore, the application and every retained component are those of the base. Images that must change: Frameworks/S2ArmEngine.framework/S2ArmEngine, Runner. Build-only delivery: Flutter and native test groups not run (AGENTS.md). Nothing has run on an iPhone; no frame-rate or rendering claim: the engine's README rows say what was measured in the logs and what the next test must show.
